chunks.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُوسَى اَلْمُتَوَكِّلُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ اَلسَّعْدَاوَابِيُّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اَلرِّضَا ع أَنَّهُ قَالَ

translations.en: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Mutawakkil narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'dabadi narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibn Faddal, from al-Rida (peace be upon him), that he said:

chunks.arabic_text: مَنْ وَالَى أَعْدَاءَ اَللَّهِ فَقَدْ عَادَى أَوْلِيَاءَ اَللَّهِ وَ مَنْ عَادَى أَوْلِيَاءَ اَللَّهِ فَقَدْ عَادَى اَللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى وَ حَقٌّ عَلَى اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يُدْخِلَهُ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ

translations.en: He who befriends the enemies of Allah has indeed antagonized the friends of Allah, and whoever antagonizes the friends of Allah has indeed antagonized Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, and it is incumbent upon Allah, Mighty and Majestic, to admit him into the fire of Hell.

en.summary: In this hadith from *Sifat al-Shia*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) establishes a direct theological link between political/spiritual alignment with Allah's enemies and the inevitable consequence of Hellfire. This narration underscores the Shia concept of *al-wala' wa al-baraa'* (affiliation and disaffiliation), where enmity towards the *Awliya'* is equated with enmity towards Allah Himself, making divine retribution a just decree. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the spiritual status of the Imams as the true friends of God.
en.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of befriending the enemies of Allah according to Imam al-Rida?
